queries: WITH per AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS o FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amount FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall v WHERE p.avg_amount > v.o) SELECT k.event_name, k.avg_amount, k.avg_amount - (SELECT o FROM overall) AS diff_from_overall, k.avg_amount / (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM kept) AS ratio_to_kept_avg FROM kept k

WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name AS event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING AVG(b.amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per_name), kept AS (SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amount FROM per_name p, overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.event_name, k.avg_amount AS average_budgeted_amount, k.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall, k.avg_amount / ka.kept_avg AS ratio_to_kept_avg FROM kept k, overall o, kept_avg ka ORDER BY k.event_name

assumptions.assumption: Events are grouped by event_name, so distinct events sharing a name are pooled into one average. Event names whose budget amounts are all NULL have a NULL average. They are left out of the overall average and cannot be kept.

responses.sql: WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name AS event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING AVG(b.amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per_name), kept AS (SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amount FROM per_name p, overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.event_name, k.avg_amount AS average_budgeted_amount, k.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall, k.avg_amount / ka.kept_avg AS ratio_to_kept_avg FROM kept k, overall o, kept_avg ka ORDER BY k.event_name

assumptions.assumption: Events are grouped by event_name (distinct events sharing a name are pooled into one group); budget lines are inner-joined to events, so unmatched lines are dropped.
Event names whose budget amounts are all NULL have no average and are excluded from the overall average (each remaining name counts once).

assumptions.assumption: Event names are grouped as distinct event_name strings, so different events sharing a name are pooled into one average over all their budget lines; each name counts once in the overall average.
Event names whose budget amounts are all NULL have no average and are excluded from the overall average.
